rationale: This is a fairly standard employment agreement for a senior software engineer role. The compensation package is competitive ($145K base + bonus + equity + benefits), and the at-will nature allows either party to terminate. The main concerns are the 12-month US-wide non-compete, 18-month non-solicitation, perpetual confidentiality, and broad IP assignment. The sign-on bonus creates a 1-year golden handcuff. The 4-week severance is minimal but typical for at-will employment. Overall, the terms are market-standard for Texas tech employment.
negotiation_points: Try to narrow non-compete geographic scope or reduce to 6 months
Negotiate higher severance (2-3 months instead of 4 weeks)
Add accelerated vesting if terminated without cause
Clarify IP assignment exclusions (e.g., truly independent side projects)
Request sign-on bonus forgiveness schedule (e.g., 1/12 per month instead of pro-rata)
Negotiate guaranteed bonus percentage instead of discretionary
Request more PTO (18-20 days for senior level)
acceptable_for: Software engineers comfortable with standard tech employment terms, seeking stable employment with growth company, willing to commit for 12+ months
